Description / Purpose: CL detector type, manufacturer, model, collection optics (e.g., parabolic mirror, elliptical mirror, light guide), and spectral detection configuration (PMT for panchromatic, CCD/EMCCD for spectral, multi-channel for pseudo-color CL).
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., 'Gatan MonoCL4, parabolic mirror, PMT 190-900 nm + CCD spectrometer 300-800 nm' | 'Gatan ChromaCL2, 4-channel RGBV PMT' | 'Oxford Instruments MonoCL'

Description / Purpose: CL data collection strategy. Panchromatic: total light intensity collected by PMT across the full detector wavelength range. Spectral point: full CL spectrum at discrete point locations. Hyperspectral map: full CL spectrum acquired at each pixel of a raster scan.
Example / Allowed Content: Panchromatic | Spectral point | Hyperspectral map | Multi-channel pseudo-color | Multiple (specify) | Other: specify | N/A | None

Description / Purpose: Diffraction grating specification for spectral or hyperspectral CL acquisition, including groove density and blaze wavelength. Not applicable to panchromatic-only acquisition.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., '1200 gr/mm, 500 nm blaze' | '300 gr/mm, 500 nm blaze' | '150 gr/mm (near-IR)' | 'N/A (panchromatic only)'

Description / Purpose: Acquisition time per pixel (hyperspectral map mode) or per spectrum (spectral point mode), in ms or s. Longer integration improves signal-to-noise but increases beam dose and acquisition time.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., '800 µs (hyperspectral map)' | '30 s (spectral point)' | '80 ms (panchromatic map)'

Description / Purpose: Detection wavelength range of the CL system in nm. The range is set by the detector sensitivity and any optical filters installed.
Reference light source or standard material used to calibrate the wavelength axis of the CL spectrometer. Required for quantitative spectral CL and hyperspectral mapping.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., 'Mercury lamp (Hg line 546.1 nm)' | 'Neon discharge lamp' | 'None'
